# PolymerFTS 0.10.0

Changes since v0.9.1 include new SCFT and field-theoretic simulation capabilities, numerical corrections, and wheel-based Python installation.

## Added

- A CPU-FFTW backend alongside CPU-MKL and CUDA.
- Non-orthogonal cells, space-group reduced bases and CrysFFT acceleration, with expanded support for non-periodic boundaries. Continuous chains offer `rqm4`, `rk2` and `cn-adi2`; discrete chains use their dedicated propagator solver.
- Canonical SCFT thermodynamics: full and relative Helmholtz free energies, molecular chemical potentials, grand potentials and binary bulk coexistence calculations for incompressible blends.
- Custom Langevin integrators and observable callbacks, including extension state in checkpoints. Built-in methods are LM (the default) and Euler-Maruyama.
- Spatial smearing for SCFT and FTS, and well-tempered metadynamics (WTMD) for L-FTS.
- Complex Langevin FTS and a browser simulation script builder, both beta.
- Bidirectional PSCF conversion, including preparation of PolymerFTS simulation scripts.
- Expanded numerical regression coverage for propagators, conservation, stress, structure functions, contour refinement, backend agreement and restart equivalence.

## Changed

- CPU and CUDA backends share the propagator computation layer. Memory saving uses contour checkpoints and recomputation; see the input migration notes below.
- Anderson mixing solves its history system with SVD through LAPACKE, improving robustness for dependent or ill-conditioned histories.
- SCFT results distinguish relative and full canonical free energies. `free_energy` is relative to the homogeneous state at the same composition; use `free_energy_absolute` for composition derivatives and canonical-to-grand-canonical transformations. The v0.9.1 log used the field-theoretic Hamiltonian with its constant omitted, so match energy conventions before comparing results. Phase coexistence uses the reference-species quantities in [Phase Equilibrium](https://github.com/yongdd/langevin-fts/blob/v0.10.0/docs/theory/PhaseEquilibrium.md).
- L-FTS retries a failed saddle solve with the same proposed fields and noise by default. Exhausting the retries raises `SaddlePointError` and records failure in `run_status.json`. Set `saddle.failure_policy="resample"` to request noise resampling explicitly.
- Direct calls to `SymmetricPolymerTheory.compute_hamiltonian(...)` now take the computation box. `compute_h_deriv_chin(..., phi=...)` needs concentrations when the auxiliary-field mapping depends on the interaction parameters or a field is dropped. The simulation classes supply these arguments internally.

## Fixed

The following bugs were present in v0.9.1 and are fixed in v0.10.0.

- **L-FTS structure-function normalization:** recorded values were too small by the number of monomer types. Multiply saved v0.9.1 values by two for AB systems or three for ABC systems to correct this normalization error.
- **Multi-monomer Hamiltonian:** corrected linear and constant coefficients computed before eigenvector sign normalization and scaling. These could give incorrect absolute energies for systems with three or more monomer types and unequal interactions.
- **Interaction-energy derivatives:** corrected `dH/d(chi N)` for multi-monomer systems, including the interaction-dependent rotation of auxiliary fields and contributions from dropped modes. This removes missing terms and spurious jumps when eigenvector signs change.
- **Branched-chain aggregation:** certain continuous chains with repeated multiblock side chains on unequal backbone blocks counted downstream blocks twice, giving incorrect concentrations and partition-consistency failures. Aggregated and unaggregated calculations now agree.
- **L-FTS restart and recording:** corrected previous-noise restoration for single-real-field systems such as AB melts and avoided re-solving the loaded saddle point. Failed proposals no longer advance the accepted-step counter or silently skip scheduled recordings.
- **Failed construction:** native objects release already allocated resources when initialization throws, preventing leaks during subsequent construction attempts.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/yongdd/langevin-fts/blob/v0.10.0/CHANGELOG.md) for details of these fixes and their affected conditions.

## Removed

- ADAM. Inputs using `optimizer.name="adam"` must switch to the Anderson-mixing configuration (`optimizer.name="am"`) documented in [Parameters](https://github.com/yongdd/langevin-fts/blob/v0.10.0/docs/references/Parameters.md).

## Upgrade notes

### Installation

Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/yongdd/langevin-fts/blob/v0.10.0/docs/getting-started/Installation.md) to build a wheel for your environment and install it with pip. MKL and FFTW have separate setup paths. Wheel builds require CMake 3.25.2+, a C++20 compiler, spglib and LAPACKE, with at least one computational backend. CUDA builds also require toolkit 12.2+. Python 3.11+ and NumPy 2+ are required; the supplied Anaconda environment uses Python 3.14.

### Migrating v0.9.1 inputs

The following v0.9.1 parameter names have supported aliases:

| Previous name | Current name |
| --- | --- |
| `distinct_polymers` | `polymers` |
| `box_is_altering` | `relax_cell` |
| `scale_stress` | `stress_scale` |
| `blocks[].fraction` | `blocks[].monomer_fractions` |
| `recording.recording_period` | `recording.checkpoint_interval` |
| `recording.sf_computing_period` | `recording.sample_interval` |
| `recording.sf_recording_period` | `recording.statistics_save_interval` |

The previous names in this table remain accepted, but supplying both names for the same setting raises an error.

Replace `reduce_gpu_memory_usage` with `reduce_memory` explicitly: the old key is not an alias. The new memory-saving algorithm stores selected contour checkpoints and recomputes intervening propagators.

### Checkpoint migration

New checkpoints use format version 2 and retain full RNG state, previous noise, auxiliary fields, pending measurements and custom integrator/callback state.

**v0.9.1 checkpoints are unversioned.** Loading one requires `continue_run(path, allow_legacy=True)` and emits a warning: settings cannot be verified and pending measurements cannot be recovered. Legacy files cannot restore custom integrators or callbacks. Do not assume identical trajectories across releases.

v0.9.1 does not restore the complete state in new checkpoints; resume them with v0.10.0. See [Extensions](https://github.com/yongdd/langevin-fts/blob/v0.10.0/docs/internals/Extensions.md) for custom methods, observables and restart contracts.

**Full changes:** https://github.com/yongdd/langevin-fts/compare/v0.9.1...v0.10.0
